    • getOrCreateHandler

      private RMIClientHandler getOrCreateHandler(ClientRMIInterface callback)
      Returns the existing handler for the given client stub, or creates one if none exists. The handler removes itself from the session cache when the client disconnects.
      Parameters:
      callback - RMI client callback stub
      Returns:
      handler bound to callback
